concerns.text: The plan substitutes the required CodeVulnBench (LLM‑generated) and Juliet Test Suite (human‑written) datasets with a single verified JavaScript parquet dataset used as a ‘proxy’. This proxy does not provide the necessary LLM vs. human source distinction nor the language diversity (Python/Java) required by the research question, making the dataset inappropriate for answering the primary hypothesis.

FR‑001 mandates downloading the CodeVulnBench and Juliet datasets. Because no verified URLs are available, the pipeline aborts early with an error. Consequently, the core analysis (negative‑binomial regression comparing LLM‑generated vs. human code) cannot be executed, violating the functional requirement and rendering the implementation plan unable to fulfill the research objective.
